title: VDBE operation access, operand mutation, and jump patching

scope.rationale: These accessors and mutators form the source builder patching interface: current/last/addressed operation access, OOM dummy fallback, exact operand changes, typeof flagging, and jump-here/pop optimization. They share one INIT-state and dummy-continuation contract.
excluded_responsibilities: Debug-only ReleaseReg skipping and VDBE coverage source lines inactive in pinned profile

external_source_responsibilities: Generated canonical opcode and OPFLAG_TYPEOFARG values
dependencies.caller_closure: All active release-profile operation access/mutation and jump-patching functions are assigned, including OOM dummy reads and last-jump removal. P4 changes remain a separate ownership unit.

inputs: INIT Vdbe and valid address, except arbitrary GetOp address after sticky OOM
outputs: selected operation pointer/current address, patched operand/opcode/P5, typeof flag, jump target, or decremented nOp
contracts.ownership: No owner changes or allocations. OOM GetOp returns a process-static zero dummy rather than touching operation storage.
contracts.state_and_results: ChangeP5 and typeof target the last operation. JumpHere writes current nOp. JumpHereOrPop decrements nOp only for an immediately preceding Once/If/FkIfZero with unused P4; otherwise patches P2.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds connection mutex. No callback or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: After sticky OOM, GetOp returns zero dummy so read-only builder continuation remains valid. Mutations require source assertion preconditions.

representation_differences: C function-static zero VdbeOp is a module-static zero Zig VdbeOp.
C u8/u16 opcode/P5 values map to enum(u8)/u16 exact fields.
Inactive debug/coverage branches are excluded by the pinned profile.

oracle.protocol: The shared builder appends and mutates operations, reads current/addressed/last state, applies P5 and typeof flags, patches and removes jumps, then forces sticky OOM and reads an out-of-range address through the dummy. All are compared in a 366-observation trace.
internal_observations: current address and real pointer selection
typeof OPFLAG bit and nonmatching no-op
JumpHereOrPop nOp decrement and nonlast patch
OOM dummy zero fields and non-real identity
oracle.normalization: Pointer values normalize to real-array identity versus dummy. All operation fields/counts are exact.

assurance.oom: Sticky OOM dummy retrieval with invalid address is reached; it returns exact zero fields without touching aOp.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O/callback. Production compiler mutex remains integration obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: Source assertions constrain INIT state, addresses, jump opcode/P4 shape and nonempty last-operation access.
assurance.continuation: Mutation results remain append/fixup compatible; popped slot is overwritten by later append under source nOp semantics.
assurance.performance: Direct indexed access, static dummy, and constant-time patches preserve source complexity.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact Vdbe operation bytes and OOM owner. Production compiler remains handwritten.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Compiler migration and P4/destruction remain open.

independent_review.notes: Requires compiler integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Structured implementation spans, callers, callees, branches/cleanup, and upstream-test context must be recorded before promotion.
Port P4 replacement/ownership and operation destruction.
Migrate production compiler to source VDBE patching interface.
